_readme: Hand-entered flight purposes, kept in version control rather than only in a local
database. Rebuilding the database from scratch must not consume research that cost
someone an afternoon or a freedom-of-information request.
Matching: by the natural key first - registration plus departure time, within a few
minutes - and by flightPublicId only as a hint. The slug is derived from airport
identifications that can improve, so tying research to it means the research detaches
the moment detection gets better. That has already happened once.
Entries whose flight does not exist yet are reported and skipped, so this file can be
seeded before the pipeline has run.
status must be one of confirmed | probable | unknown, and anything other than
'unknown' needs a publisher and a source URL.
'confirmed' means a source states that THIS aircraft carried THIS mission.
'probable' means the evidence is circumstantial - typically an officially announced
trip whose dates and destination match. Matching dates are not a confirmation.

purposes.title: Pracovna cesta ministra zahranicnych veci do sidla OSN v New Yorku
purposes.description: MZVEZ SR ohlasilo pracovnu cestu ministra Juraja Blanara do USA od 12. do 16. jula 2026, kde Slovensko oficialne predstavilo kandidaturu na nestale clenstvo v Bezpecnostnej rade OSN na roky 2028-2029. Datumy sa zhoduju s tymto letom, ziadny zdroj vsak neuvadza, ze delegacia cestovala prave tymto lietadlom. Zhoda datumov nie je potvrdenie.

purposes.title: Navrat z pracovnej cesty ministra zahranicnych veci v OSN
purposes.description: Spiatocny usek. Rovnaka evidencia a rovnake obmedzenia ako pri ceste tam.
